facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary 6-minute walk endpoint; subgroup and biomarker signals only · Phase 3 · TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in PH-HFpEF · not yet approved
facts.indication: pulmonary hypertension due to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (PH-HFpEF)

evidence.summary: LEVEL did not meet its primary endpoint of improvement in the 6-minute walk distance versus placebo, or the key secondary endpoint of improvement in Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire total symptom score.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: least-squares mean difference 3.5 meters (SE 7.3), p=0.63. The primary endpoint was not met.
evidence.safety: TNX-103 was generally safe and well-tolerated in the LEVEL trial, and no new safety signals were observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: Tenax intends to request a Type C meeting with the FDA to present the complete LEVEL dataset together with the Company’s recommendations
